property.name: dfs.datanode.data.dir
property.description: Comma-separated list of volumes (one disk = one volume = one storage with its own storageID). An optional prefix [DISK], [SSD], [ARCHIVE] or [RAM_DISK] sets the StorageType. The DataNode distributes new blocks round-robin across the volumes (RoundRobinVolumeChoosingPolicy).

property.name: dfs.datanode.failed.volumes.tolerated
property.description: How many volumes may fail before the DataNode shuts down. Original default: 0. Here 1, so that a disk failure can be observed without losing the whole DataNode right away.

property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: Default replication factor for new files.

property.name: dfs.blocksize
property.description: Default block size (original: 128m). Suffixes k, m, g are allowed.

property.name: dfs.heartbeat.interval
property.description: Interval of the heartbeats DataNode -> NameNode (original: 3s).

property.name: dfs.blockreport.intervalMsec
property.description: Interval of the full block reports in ms (original: 21600000 = 6 h).
